title: b11618: HIP: use 64-row MMQ tiles for some quant types on RDNA3.5 (#28195)
summary: The RDNA3.5 config table selects a 64-row / 128-thread tile up to J=32 and a 128-row / 256-thread tile above that. On gfx115x the smaller tile leaves enough LDS free for a second workgroup per CU, while the larger one does not. Extend the 64-row tile to the (type, J) pairs where it measured faster on gfx1151, and leave every other entry untouched. J=96 is deliberately excluded because it did not benefit. test-backend
body:
The RDNA3.5 config table selects a 64-row / 128-thread tile up to J=32 and a

128-row / 256-thread tile above that. On gfx115x the smaller tile leaves enough

LDS free for a second workgroup per CU, while the larger one does not.

Extend the 64-row tile to the (type, J) pairs where it measured faster on

gfx1151, and leave every other entry untouched. J=96 is deliberately excluded

because it did not benefit.

test-backend-ops perf on gfx1151, 100 MUL_MAT shapes over the affected types

(N in 48..512, M both padded and unpadded), 3 rounds: median +2.1%, best

+26.0%, no shape outside run-to-run noise. 5 MUL_MAT_ID shapes: median +8.0%.

Assisted-by: Claude Opus 5
summaryZh: llama.cpp的b11618版本发布了针对AMD RDNA3.5架构（HIP后端）的重要性能优化。通过调整特定量化类型的MMQ配置表，将64行分块配置扩展到在gfx1151上表现更快的（类型, J）参数对，在保证本地计算单元（CU）双工作组并发的同时释放了LDS资源。测试表明，在100种MUL_MAT形状上中位数性能提升2.1%，最高提升达26.0%，多矩阵乘法MUL_MAT_ID形状中位数提升8.0%。
